say:1:1430243501:1.text: Yes, after Her Majesty's death, it's natural for that responsibility to fall to him.
say:1:1430243501:1.source_cn: 是的，女王崩逝之后，自然轮到他担负起这个责任。
say:1:1430243501:1.male: Yes, after Her Majesty's death, it's natural for that responsibility to fall to him.
say:1:1430243501:1.female: Yes, after Her Majesty's death, it's natural for that responsibility to fall to him.

say:2:1430243502:1.text: However, Lord Ravion isn't the Queen. He will gradually change Sal'thorin.
say:2:1430243502:1.source_cn: 但沙利叶殿下并不是女王，他会一点点的改变萨洛克兰。
say:2:1430243502:1.male: However, Lord Ravion isn't the Queen. He will gradually change Sal'thorin.
say:2:1430243502:1.female: However, Lord Ravion is the Queen. He will gradually change Sal'thorin.
